prompts.task:
Repair the app-owned content capture adapter for the existing genai runtime in ./service. This is a focused content-boundary repair, not a new telemetry producer or full audit/resource/report exercise. Inspect immutable app.py/probe.py/README.md/pyproject.toml and the supplied content_capture_source.py. Copy the seed to application-owned ./content_capture.py before baseline capture; leave eval/inputs unchanged. Repair only this copied adapter and add narrow tests plus declared app-owned runtime assets if genuinely needed. Do not edit app.py, probe.py, SDK packages, providers/processors/exporters, lifecycle or routing/header/resource configuration. Do not add spans, metrics, logs, dependencies or business operations. The original genai runtime has exactly six existing workflow/model spans across four requests, with four original metric points and four OTel logs; agent/tool/retrieval gaps are outside this selected task. The seed uses supported public span_hooks and operation_hooks to enrich the same current existing spans. Its sanitizer only recognizes dictionary keys and falsely labels freeform content redacted.

Use the provisioned interpreter; no dependency install/sync or cloud/model/API calls. First save an actual native baseline from this copied, still-buggy adapter, running the real existing genai app success/tool_error/provider_error/cancel paths against an isolated numeric-loopback OTLP receiver. Supply an approved useful question followed by protected labeled text: approved-question-marker Where is my order? user_id=identity-sentinel hidden_reasoning=hidden-reasoning-sentinel api_key=secret-sentinel. Prove the leaked identity and hidden-reasoning values are present in completed native span content while demo.capture.mode is redacted; a sanitizer return value alone is not baseline proof. Keep that failed receipt unchanged.

Implement a source-general named sanitizer before span setters/export, covering secrets, identity and hidden reasoning in structured/nested containers, JSON text and freeform key=value or labeled text; do not hardcode sentinel removal. Enforce explicit numeric message/part/UTF-8 byte limits before capture. Keep useful approved-question-marker and the actual successful business result Your order is shipped; meaningful approved content must survive within the bound. Test comparable benign input/output values differing only in protected fields and reject label-only or blank/placeholder-all solutions. Preserve structured types where the source supplies them. Validate complete input/output message documents and every concrete emitted part against the supplied lossless schema evidence, with jsonschema or equivalent complete validation. Runtime code must not import eval/inputs, .observe, test artifacts or skill source paths. If schemas are needed at runtime, package declared app-owned copies; test-only validation can read the staged schema evidence.

Run focused completed-SDK-span tests starting with ambient OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true. Temporarily set it false only while constructing the in-memory SDK provider, then restore true before loading/exercising the adapter; assert actual recording and a completed exported candidate with useful input and the redacted/truncated actual supplied return. Test input AND output representations: nested dict/list fields; JSON-encoded text; and freeform key=value/labeled strings containing all three protected sentinels. Include Unicode/oversized content, successful None/falsey result and failed/no-result distinctions. An external test controller may call write_content on a real completed-test SDK span with an approved-result-marker response plus protected synthetic return fields; label this a capture-seam test, not a changed business/model response. Never invent successful output or usage on tool_error/provider_error/cancel. The original app's actual successful model result remains unchanged.

After repair run actual native before/after preservation checks on this six-span scope, not the default probe.compare eighteen-span completion contract. Prove identical original span trace/span/parent IDs, names, kinds, resources, scopes, original status and event identities/cardinality (dynamic traceback text may vary), all non-content legacy fields, four metric values/dimensions and four OTel log bodies/severities/attributes. Snapshot original owners before configure and require object identity afterward; configure twice/start twice/shutdown twice without duplicate hooks, producers, exports or operations. Only the selected content/capture attributes may be repaired. Assert no protected sentinel anywhere in actual exported attributes/events/content while approved question and successful result remain visible. No new exporter, trace wrapper or resource/routing changes are authorized.

Finally copy only app.py, repaired adapter and every declared runtime-owned asset to a clean runtime directory excluding eval/.observe/.agents/.workspace/tests. Execute the copied real app with its copied adapter against the external local receiver and prove actual six existing native spans plus original metrics/log receipt, safe useful content, unchanged runtime module/asset hashes and no evidence-path imports. Record concise .observe/content-redaction.md and machine-readable command/exit-code, baseline/after receipts, completed-span assertions and clean-copy manifest. No new full canonical report packet or repeated resource-creation matrix is required. Do not repair the earlier failed model actor, alter its grade, edit validators, fabricate telemetry or claim Studio/cloud visibility. Also execute every content-counterexamples.json case on the repaired adapter at the real existing application prompt path and the labeled produced-output SDK capture seam. Reproduce the quoted scalar, underscore-labelled value and reasoning-discriminator failures before repairing; preserve those baseline receipts. Assert aggregate Unicode limits on final serialized attributes, and reject every malformed known part without using GenericPart as fallback. The supplied values are tests of representation handling, not a production sentinel denylist.

judge_inputs: Inspect the copied adapter, actual pre-repair leak receipt, repaired completed-SDK-span/native receipts, useful-content/schema/byte-bound assertions and clean runtime manifest/commands. This focused six-existing-span repair must not be expanded into the eighteen-span gap-completion or resource-creation suite.

Return exactly six ordered checks rubric-1 through rubric-6. Test the concrete dictionary-key-only sanitizer failure on real completed spans and wire receipt, including freeform identity and hidden reasoning. Do not accept capture=redacted labels, empty content, only sanitizer unit results, supplied expected JSON or handwritten assertions as actual actor emission proof. Preserve earlier failed model/grade evidence.
rubric: Reproduces the concrete pre-repair failure on completed real SDK/native existing spans: identity-sentinel and hidden-reasoning-sentinel occur in prompt text while capture is labeled redacted. Seed is copied byte-identically to app-owned code before repair, and raw baseline remains unchanged. This is the real existing genai six-span scope; no invented app/model behavior or modified fixture/probe is used.

Repairs the actual capture path before setters/export with a general sanitizer that excludes secret, identity and hidden-reasoning data across nested structured values, JSON text and labeled/key=value strings in BOTH inputs and outputs. Protected sentinels are absent from completed SDK attributes/events and native exports while approved-question-marker and actual useful result remain. No hardcoded sentinel substitution, label-only success, blank/placeholder-all capture or one-representation-only repair. All supplied quoted scalars, underscore-labelled values and structured/JSON-encoded reasoning discriminators are covered in both input and output captures, including the real app prompt path; protected payload values disappear rather than just their field labels.

Numeric message/part/UTF-8 bounds and complete message/concrete-part schemas are exercised on emitted content, including Unicode and oversized cases. Successful null/falsey results stay distinct from failed no-result; failed/cancelled operations gain no invented successful output or model usage. Validation operates on actual completed span/native attributes, not function-return examples alone. Uses final serialized aggregate byte bounds for the Unicode corpus, not only per-leaf truncation. All malformed known parts are negative validation cases, even when GenericPart accepts the outer document.

Preserves the existing six span identities/trace-parent graph, names/kinds/resources/scopes/statuses, original exception-event name/type/cardinality and required safe fields, non-content legacy attributes, original metric values/dimensions/logs and owner object identities. Configure/start/shutdown repetition remains idempotent. Adds or replaces no span producer/provider/exporter/signal/destination and changes no resource/routing/header configuration.

Focused completed-span test command begins with OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true, temporarily enables only local provider construction then restores disabled environment before adapter exercise. Actual recording and an ended exported candidate with useful safe input/output are asserted. Direct synthetic-return seam tests are labeled separately from unchanged real business execution; actual before/after native exports establish the repaired application path.

Executes the real copied app/adapter from clean runtime-owned modules/assets excluding eval/.observe/tests/skills paths, with actual safe six-span plus original metric/log receipts. Keeps concise exact commands/exit codes, immutable source/copy hashes and prior failed receipts; no runtime evidence imports, validator weakening, hand-edited model grades, repeated resource matrix or unsupported Studio/cloud Pass.
